title: Smart Queue · What and why
text: Smart Queue fills cancelled appointments with patients who want an earlier visit. In Puerto Rico, waits can run for months, so every open slot matters.

title: 01 · Ana today: hours of calls by hand
text: Meet Ana Martínez, Dr. Rivera's office assistant. Today, every cancellation means hours of calls, searching the list, and chasing replies, all by hand.

title: 02 · María cancels in two taps
text: María Rodríguez can't make her two o'clock visit. In her patient view, she cancels in two taps. No phone call needed.

title: 03 · The AI assistant (simulated) detects and scans
text: The AI assistant detects the opening right away and scans four waiting patients. Nicolás is only free in the mornings, so he is excluded.

title: 04 · Its reasoning, step by step
text: José, Elena and Camila share priority three. José's request is the oldest, from October fourth, so he is selected. Elena is next.

title: 05 · José: an earlier visit, no calls
text: José gets an offer: October eighth at two, fourteen days sooner. His current visit stays until he decides.

title: 06 · José decides
text: José accepts with one confirmation. The patient always keeps the decision.

title: 07 · The schedule updates itself
text: The assistant moves José to October eighth, releases his October twenty-second visit, and updates the waitlist from four to three.

title: 08 · Ana is notified
text: Ana gets one notification summarizing every change. No calls, no approvals. Her time goes back to the patients in front of her.

title: 09 · Dr. Rivera: fewer empty slots · separate synthetic month
text: For Dr. Rivera, fewer empty slots. In the only measured Puerto Rico dataset, about fifteen percent of appointments were cancelled. Smart Queue turns that lost time back into care.

title: 10 · Why it's different in Puerto Rico
text: Large US systems offer this inside one big record system, in English. Local Puerto Rico tools confirm and remind; we found none that refills cancelled slots. Smart Queue is bilingual and logs every move.

title: Smart Queue — Less Waiting. Better Care.
text: Today the assistant is simulated and rule-based. Smart Queue: less waiting, better care.
